# oneprovider_vm_tag (Data Source)

Fetches an existing tag by label within a VM project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    oneprovider = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/MadJlzz/oneprovider"
    }
  }
}

provider "oneprovider" {}

data "oneprovider_vm_project" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

data "oneprovider_vm_tag" "managed" {
  name    = "terraform managed"
  project = data.oneprovider_vm_project.production.id
}

output "tag_id" {
  value = data.oneprovider_vm_tag.managed.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact tag label. If labels are duplicated, the first match is returned.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project UUID. If omitted, searches the account's default project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tag ID to use in the tags attribute of a VM instance.
